name: NEARER_KINSMAN
canonical: the nearer kinsman who refused to redeem, a stocky Hebrew townsman of Bethlehem of middle age, sun-worn olive skin, a guarded calculating bearded face with darting eyes, dark hair greying, robed in a drab grey-brown layered mantle and head-cloth, stooping to draw off his sandal as he turns evasively away
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
